title: campanula spatulata subsp. spruneriana
intro: Campanula spatulata subsp. spruneriana, commonly known as the Balkan bellflower, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and skin conditions, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Campanula spatulata subsp. spruneriana include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate pain, making it a popular natural remedy. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified through various scientific studies.
